name: wizard
description: Multi-step form wizard composing stepper + card panels + field-group + buttons. Fully declarative: a single l-data `{ step }` drives step visibility and indicator state, and faqir-validate's on-valid hook advances the step, blocks advancing while the active step is invalid, and dispatches a completion event on the final step. The stepper's steps are buttons bound to the same `step`, so clicking a completed step goes back to its panel. Zero custom JS.

changes.note: Clickable stepper navigation, additive. The stepper's steps are type=button elements that set `step` on click: a completed step goes back to its panel, the current step carries a bound aria-current="step", a step still ahead is :disabled so moving forward stays Next and its validation, a visually hidden status part says "Completed", and the connector before a completed step turns completed. Next, Back, validation, submission and faqir:wizard-complete are unchanged, and the stepper still has one step part per panel.

steps.description: The stepper progress indicator (a nested data-ui='stepper'). Its steps are type=button elements bound to the same step: completed steps go back to their panel, steps ahead are disabled

panel.description: One step's content, a nested data-ui='card'; shown only when its step is active via :hidden binding

back.description: Go to the previous step; disabled on the first step

next.description: Submit-typed button that triggers per-step validation then advances; hidden on the final step

submit.description: Submit-typed button shown only on the final step; completes the wizard

complete.description: Completion message, revealed by CSS when the form reaches data-state='submitted'

required_attrs: aria-label or aria-labelledby on the form element
the current stepper step carries aria-current="step" (bound to step), the others none
every stepper step is a type=button element, so clicking one never submits the form
label[for] matching each input id inside every step
aria-describedby pointing to the field-group error message
role="status" on the completion message so its reveal is announced

keyboard.Tab: move focus between the reachable stepper steps, the active step's controls and the nav buttons
keyboard.Enter / Space on a stepper step: go back to that step's panel; a step still ahead is disabled, so forward is always Next

notes: Stepper navigation is linear: a completed step can be revisited, a later one only through Next, which validates the step being left.

templates.html: {fields}
